reviews.text: The doctors are thorough and give you plenty of options if cost is an issue. Also I have 5 dogs and I’m extremely satisfied with the way they are taking care of. The staff is great and Dr. Denish  and Dr. Katz are the best!

It was my Western Hognose snakes first vet appointment, Dr Denish was very attentive and gentle with him and everything went great :) he took the time to explain everything thoroughly and made sure my snake was healthy… We will definitely be back, thank you so much for taking care of Porkchop!

Have had some good ones and then also bad where I ended up having to put a few of my fur babies down so they wouldn’t suffer I miss them and now I’m dealing with my Ten year old orange and white domestic who has hyper thyroidism so trying to manage that but the staff and drs are amazing with him couldn’t ask for any better
It's great to be able to take my guinea pigs to a vet that specializes in small animals. Everyone was great, and I was very confident my boys were getting the best care, and I got the best advice.
My fur baby always gets the best of care . The doctors are very good and the staff is very friendly.

Extremely expensive vet clinic, and I honestly feel like the focus is more on making money than helping pets.
I’ve been there several times for small concerns, and they performed expensive tests without clearly explaining that the bill would be $700+.
I’m a cat breeder and handle routine vaccinations myself. I was recently told they wouldn’t refill my cat’s prescription urinary food without an appointment and a vaccine, even though nobody told me this was required during my previous visit.
They also quoted me $1,600 for a cat spay — absolutely shocking.
On top of that, the receptionist who called me was very rude. Very disappointing experience. I would not recommend this clinic.

Met with great vets there Dr adam Denish  and Dr Trina Mathis. Dr mathis treated Jim, thats my dog. She did an amazing job and didnot make me spend money on unnecessary tests. I felt jim was treated great!

I took my cat here for a wellness check. As soon as we arrived, we received such a warm and friendly greeting. The staff’s friendliness, knowledge base and excellent customer service has made a repeat customer out of me.

I have been going to Rhawnhurst for over 18 years. First with my dog Scooby who passed May 8, 2018. Now with my cat JJ. The doctors and staff are the best. So thoughtful and caring. I appreciate all they do for my pets. Thank You.
The staff there is awesome!

I just wanted to say thank you for your continued care with our new fur babies. You were the sole care provider for our first two furry children Rocco & Sparky. You always had the right answers and when the time finally came to make adult decisions you were understanding and honest. That helped to ease our burden.
And now you are once again responsible for our two newest fur baby puppies  Phineas and Patrick. We look forward to your continued wonderful care  with our greatest joy!
They explain things very thoroughly and carefully. Treated my pets with such care
Always professional and compassionate

Great vets and support staff! We have been bringing our cats, rabbits, and large breed dogs to them for about 15 years. Always knowledgeable and kind. We are very happy with Rhawnhurst Animal hospital!
Always a pleasant experience there. Made my Matteo comfortable for his yearly shots. Only place I trust.

I gave a 4 * because I have to go again for shot, My experience with other vets were not good ones. I'm looking forward to make this my final vet for my dog it's exhausting looking for a good veterinarian. I'm sorry but being being on SS it is expensive, but after looking around it's worth it.Thankyou, Princess is doing very well with her medicine and is definitely happier.
They really treat my cat like a VIP every visit. I really appreciate that.  They are very accommodating to your needs here as well.
They know how to handle deficult situations.
The vets and staff are professional and caring.  They take great care of our dogs.  We wouldn't go anywhere else.
Great staff.  Very friendly.   Really care about their patients.   Price was very reasonable.  Parking not so good.
Very caring professional and knowagble staff

We took our 2 cats to get shots and the doctor was so caring. I used the Vet mobile once . Both TeTe& Lilboy were very relaxed when the doctor cared for them. They were street cats before I adopted them.

We were very upset, nervous and on edge because we are very concerned about our cat's health and, to compound matters, it's also very difficult getting her into the pet carrier as she does not like to be held and taken out of the house, at all, not a very pleasant experience. Dr Romanzi and her entire staff were very accommodating, friendly, and patient with us from the time we arrived until departure. They were very thorough and explained everything to us in a clear and concise manner, putting us at ease. Dr Romanzi gave a thorough exam, she was very gentle and kind with our cat; you can immediately tell how passionate and genuinely caring she and her staff are regarding animals, which is very important. I highly recommend Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital to anyone for their pet care needs.
This practice exemplifies professionalism, expertise and compassion. All my pets are well-taken care of by the doctors and staff upon the visits and follow-up calls.  Highly recommended!
Dr Denish is the best! He is extremely thorough and honest. I don’t know what my family would do without him and his excellent care and knowledge.
They're always so nice and talkative and they're nice to they're nice at least to Mom's
I took my sick chihuahua to Dr Denish for a severe cough. The doctor made me and my dog feel comfortable as he did a thorough examination. He sent us home feeling positive about Zeppelin’s recovery.
Absolutely love these guys they're always very nice and I know exactly what to do they're just very nice about both both both offices are really wonderful

My recent experience was the same as all the others. Excellent service by front office staff as well as caring medical professionals.appoinrments on time and information taken and given as needed. From my exotic pets, birds , reptiles and bunnies , to the normal dogs and cats all of them have received human grade medical care for years. I consider my animals Fortunate to have such wonderful medical care and attribute longevity to the care they receive.
There always friendly and great with all my furry family members.
I've been taking pets there for years. A bit pricey, but trustworthy. Dr Denish is wonderful and staff is nice!
Had a great visit.. staff is so caring and helpful.

Wonderful veterinary care!  Dr. Denish and the entire staff are professional, friendly, compassionate and truly love the animals!  Dr. Denish takes the time to explain everything to you about your pet's health.  Very thorough.  I recommend Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital without hesitation.

I recently moved and needed to find a closer exotic vet for my ferret. It was time for her yearly adrenal implant and I just wanted to get her overall checked out. I looked online and came across Rhawnhurst. The reviews seemed good so I made an appt. Best decision I ever made. One visit today with Dr Denish and I learned more about what was going on with my girl than the last 6 years of having her with another vet. Not only did he explain in detail everything about her adrenal disease, he talked me through the checkup and addressed the concerns I had with insulinoma and losing my other ferrets to it. He did a sugar check on her and we were able to get an early diagnosis and start treatment! It is very hard to find a good vet for exotics but Dr. Denish is such an amazing one! If you have a ferret, or any exotic and you live in the Philadelphia area, this is where you need to go. Hands down, the best. All of my guys will be going here from now on :).

Thank you Dr Denish for taking care of my girl, getting her an early diagnosis, and making me feel at ease. You and your whole office are amazing.

My dog got her semi annual check up. Dr. Denish has established a very compassionate and cooperative practice. Dr
Denish inherited me when he bought the practice and he helped my 3 huskeys enjoy long and healthy lives. Would never use another Vet
Bear had his yearly all is well even throw he 161/2 but he doesn't know it lol. service was great and tech are good and doc too, price fair$
Love the techs at the vet.  They were super friendly to my pets.  I have been going to them for over 10 years.   Highly recommended.

After using another vet for over 30 yrs we were a little unsure where to go. Plus deciding on another pet was scary enough. Well we couldn't of picked a better place. The ladies at the front desk welcomed us and you could tell it was more than a job. The animals were entered into waiting rooms like real members of the family .So if another dog didn't want to be there your dog would not be upset.  My Ruby was treated so kind she didn't even make a sound or try to run away. It wasn't the extra incentive of cheese. Tv might have Dr. Pol but our Ruby has Dr. Mick. She answered all my husband's questions and explained everything. So glad we found Ruby and Rhawnhurst animal hospital.
We love the Drs. and the staff! My dog gets great care!
The staff is great.

I ended up at Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital by chance, my pet had a stroke and despite our best efforts and a brief moment of hope, he started declining fast. Given his advanced age, there was only one option. Rhawnhurst was an associated location of a vet we had seen previously and had a timeslot open to help ease his passing. We took it. I’m so happy we did, the staff and doctor showed such gentle kindness that I don’t even have the words to describe it. The showered my buddy in love and showed him the upmost respect. I KNOW they made his final moments as pleasant as they possibly could have been. I am forever thankful. It makes this depressing moment better knowing there are still such good people in the world. You can be assured your little loved ones are in good hands here.

Dr. Adam Denish is the best. He has loved all animals from young age and all he ever wanted to do in life. I appreciate Adam for taken care of my best friend Cinnamon and keeping her well: I trust no one else. Staff is incredible.
My dog was injured and they made sure I was fit into their schedule. The doctor was awesome, caring and loving. I was very pleased with the care my dog received.

I recently started to bring my cats to Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital located on Bustleton Avenue.  Dr Romanzi and the staff were great and took very good care of them.  They were wonderful and compassionate when one of my cats had cancer and had to be euthanized.  I highly recommend the veterinarian and staff at this facility.
Great staff and very caring vets!
I always have an amazing experience with Dr. Denish.   He has been my vet for almost 30 years!
I have been taking my babies to Dr. Denish for over a decade. He's great, the staff is wonderful and my babies love them!!
The drs and staff are so friendly and accommodating.   Highly recommend Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital.
From the moment we walked in we were made to feel "at home". Our cat even enjoyed her mani-pedi! Dr Mathis & everyone else are just the best & treat our cat as if she's their own.
All the staff is kind and helpful. Will be coming here for my kitties for the foreseeable future.
This place is gross and should be closed permanently! All a money grab! Be careful with your pets they like to misdiagnose!
I love both the Rhawnhurst and Elkins park locations, all staff and vets treat us with the greatest respect and always take care of my boys!

Terrible  experience with Dr Mathis.
She never examined my cat with me in the room.
The techs drew blood and the cost was 353.00.
I will never she her again.  I have always seen Dr Cantor in the past. And think he is excellent.
There is no better Vet that I know than Dr. Denish.   He is attentive, caring, and knows animals.   I wouldn't think of taking my dogs to any other doctor.

What a great place. The nurse and doctor were so gentle with my guinea piggy girls & were very informative. They were so helpful to this newbie fur mom.  Love that I have an exotic vet option in my neighborhood!
It’s always a pleasure with Dr. Denish. He is the absolute best. The staff is awesome and patient and understanding all my needs, questions, etc. thank you all for all you do!
Our dog was well taken care of. The staff is great and communicated with us when needed.
Very pleasant and knowledgeable employees.

I’ve been coming in for 26 years and my dogs have always had the best treatment possible.  The people here truly love animals and it shows. My most recent visit was a testament to the people here. My dog just started having seizures (he’s 10) and I feared the worst. I left feeling optimistic and happy about Finn’s treatment, health and quality of life.  The Doctors here are just amazing and brilliant, same as the Staff!

I would recommend them to everyone- your Furbaby is in great hands at Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital!
Great place very helpful awesome staff.

The staff was incredibly friendly and Dr. Denish was excellent. They were very patient and caring with both my dog and I. The test results were provided quickly and the doctor thoroughly explained everything.
Dr. Denish is amazing! So knowledgeable and took amazing care of my rats!
What’s the highest anyone paid for a wellness exam?
Great prices and doctors

My experience at Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital is always lovely. The staff and doctors are caring, knowledgeable, and thorough. They treated my senior dog (shih tzu) with gentle care at his last visit for his fur and skin and gave him plenty of cuddles while he waited to be picked up. The after care instructions were detailed with a plan for follow-up.

Unprofessional and disappointing service. Upon arrival, the door was locked, and a rude attendant abruptly informed me they only assist customers with prior appointments. When I inquired about availability, I was told to wait 10–15 days for assistance. This ranks among the worst customer service experiences I’ve had in years. I strongly advise avoiding this business entirely.

I love that place! The best people work here! It’s a shame Dr Cantor had to leave! My rottie is a handful. Dr. Cantor was really good with her. I’m sure the other doctors will be just as good with her. Everyone is amazing!
I've been going to Rhawnhurst for years now.  I highly recommend them.  The doctors and technicians are caring, understanding and always helpful.  Thank you all!
Thank you so much Sharri for the kind review!
Excellent staff and doctor. They absolutely loved my cat.And she loved the staff back. We will be back. Very  nice inside too.

I love Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital.  I have been taking my cat there for a year now.  Every single time has been a good experience.  They are very gentle with my cat, and also very thorough.  I highly recommend this veterinarian to anyone looking for a trustworthy place to take their pet/s.

The ONLY reason this place is even getting two stars from me is bc I believe in Dr.Denish. However this past Friday I was there and unfortunately had to put my baby to sleep. It was BY FAR THE ABSOLUTE WORST experience of my ENTIRE life. It took TWO HOURS TO DO THE JOB. I thought euthanizing an animal was supposed to be peaceful? This experience was EVERYTHING but that. The doctor made me feel uncomfortable and almost like it was a joke. I will NEVER go back there. $470 and there was no peace. Blood dripping down my girls legs, rolling her around like a doll once she was sedated, her head rolling off of the table. NEVER going back there and my family has gone there for over 20 years.

Dr. Dinesh was thorough, handled my in-pain dog with skill and understanding, and made sure I understood both the problem and the treatment. All the techs I met were friendly and professional. From start to finish, I felt my dog and I were in great hands, and I left much less anxious than when we arrived.  Would definitely recommend this practice to everyone!
Dr. Denish and his team were great. Really appreciated the exam and explanation during a tough time. Ultimately it was time for our pet, Ricky, to pass over the rainbow bridge.
The best place to take your furbabies. The Drs and staff are the best, so kind and so nice and always very helpful.
Awesome staff

Each time we take one of our furry family members to Rhawnhurst, our decision is confirmed and strengthened by the enormous weight that the entire staff lifts from us. Their ministrations to our cats is superb, their advice is awesome, their passion for helping our fur-babies is limitless and their compassion for us, their caregivers is always evident in the extreme. I cannot imagine receiving better care anywhere, and I only wish physicians who administer to humans were as comprehensive, knowledgeable, and thoughtful in every detail, every time.

The best primary vetinarian hospital I am aware of locally. Staff and physicians are very friendly and caring. Always willing to help in any way. My fur babies and I would not know what to do without them. We appreciate all of them greatly and what they do for our animals who are our family.

Everyone there at Rhawnhurst animal hospital were very friendly and accommodating.
They explained everything to me so I could understand the examination for my dog.

Dr. Dennish has taken care of all of our dogs since 2005. We completely trust in his care and clinical judgment. And the staff at Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital is amazing! We don’t live near the office but are willing to go there because we trust them with these important members of our family
They took such great care of Ashton and  Dinah Sophia.  I highly recommend them for your pets!
Love Dr Denish! I have trusted him with all my animals forever. He is definitely one if a kind doctor for all types of animals
Good
We've been taking our pets there for over 20 years. Love Dr. Denish and the entire staff. Very caring and Good with my babies.
Rhawnhurst / Elkins Park have taken excellent care of our pets over the years!
The Dr.'s and the staff are great there. They listen, they love all the fur babies in our family large and small. They take care of the each of them like they were their own.

I felt so fortunate to get an appointment with Dr. Mathis within an hour of my call to the office. (I had called my Elkins Park vet it would be a 2 week wait) these 2 practices work together. Both Dr. Mathis and the vet tech were very kind us and to my kitty Yoda… she could see he was dehydrated. Gave some fluids did some blood work. Dr. Mathis explained everything along the way, and called me two days later with the lab results and to see if the antibiotics were working and how Yoda was feeling. Wow! What a surprise. Many thanks to Dr. Mathis and her staff at Rhawnhurst Vets.
Dr. Denish and staff took amazing care of Pixie during her yearly checkup! Thank you!

Every member of the staff we've met has been friendly, professional, competent, and most importantly, has shown the utmost concern for the health and welfare of our pet.  The vets take time to listen to your questions/concerns about your pet's health and also to explain everything going on in detail.  The gals at the desk handle all the necessary paperwork and medication orders quickly and accurately.

Best animal care ANYWHERE, in my opinion.  If your pet needs a check up or medical care, I strongly suggest you try Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital.  Bet your pet will thank you for doing so!

[Update on 10/16/2021] Every word I previously stated in my review is still 100% accurate, and that says a lot.  Not only are they great, but they're CONSISTENTLY GREAT over time.  Seriously...still the best care anywhere.

[Update on 12/27/2022] Another year and STILL the best care anywhere.  Still the best staff and vets you could hope for to care for your pets.

[Update on 3/16/2024] Still the best.  Still unmatched quality of care and friendliness.

[Update on 11/3/2024] The staff and vets at Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital are (still!) friendly, knowledgeable, and accommodating.  It's obvious that they truly care about the health and well being of my cat, Shadow.  I have and continue to recommend them to anyone who is searching for a place that will treat their pet with the love, caring, and expertise that they deserve.
The office is amazing. They treat your pets like they are their own.
excellent & caring service

I have been going to Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital with one of my cats for the last 6 months,  Dr. Denish is a great vet, very thorough in his examination explains what is going on and why and treats my cat with care. I'll be bringing my other cat in to see him in July for a checkup. I would highly recommend this practice.

I love Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital. My dog Charlie is not easy to deal with. Dr. Cantor is an amazing vet who works well with all the animals. I trust this vet and all the associates.  Thank you all at Rhawnhurst Animal Hospital.
